scenes.texte: GTA 6 is finally here. But where is GTA 6 Online?

scenes.texte: Rockstar presents GTA 6 as a single player experience. The PlayStation FAQ uses the same words.

carte.texte: "Grand Theft Auto VI is a single player experience."

scenes.texte: And in the sources we checked, Rockstar has not announced any official date for a GTA 6 Online mode.

scenes.texte: In 2013, GTA Online arrived about two weeks after GTA 5. Will GTA 6 follow the same path? We don't know yet.
Online or story mode: which one matters more to you? Tell me in the comments, and follow for verified GTA 6 news.
